_comment: skfem helmholtz#4: at k=40 with 10 elements/wavelength standard P1 drifts out of phase and P2 on the same mesh recovers it. Verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. The claim's k and resolution are kept verbatim; only the geometry is scaled down to a one-element-thick MeshQuad strip (322 P1 DOFs / 963 P2 DOFs on the same 160-element mesh) instead of a 2D square, which at that resolution would need ~1e5 DOFs. The claim gives no domain size: the shift reaches the claimed ~1/4 wavelength after 16 wavelengths of propagation (measured 0.252 wavelengths, 84% relative L2 error); ElementQuad2 on the identical mesh gives 0.0017 wavelengths and 0.6%. Phase is measured with Basis.probes against the analytic exp(-i k x); only thresholds, orderings and exact DOF counts are pinned.
